title.narrative: East Jerusalem Hospitals (EJH) - PEGASE support to the Palestinian Authority with a financial contribution to partially cover the outstanding invoices of medical referrals to East Jerusalem hospitals-2021

description.narrative: PEGASE programme aims to improve access to social public services, through contribution to the payment of Medical Referrals to the six East Jerusalem hospitals. The six East Jerusalem Hospitals provide a quality range of tertiary healthcare, most of which is not available elsewhere in Palestine. The financial difficulties of the Palestinian Authority have resulted in accumulation of medical referral invoices, contributing to a substantial debt and regular arrears vis-à-vis the East Jerusalem Hospitals and hindering the provision of essential health care services at these hospitals
